intro: Family-run tire and alignment shop in central Heraklion. We've been on the same street since 1970, same faces, same standards.

story.h: Two decades on the same street
story.p1: Kiaoulias Tires started as a small tire-fitting bay and has grown steadily by doing one thing well: fitting the right tire correctly, every time. No hard sell, no surprises on the invoice.
story.p2: We invested early in computerised alignment and balancing equipment because we believe precision matters as much as the tire itself. Most of our customers come back every season, that's the measure we care about.

honest.b: We'll tell you if your tires still have life in them. We'd rather you trust us than make a sale you didn't need.

precision.b: Computerised alignment and certified balancing on every job. If it's worth doing, it's worth doing right.

fast.b: Most jobs are done while you wait. Book a slot and we'll have your tires ready when you arrive.

cta.p: Walk-ins welcome. Or book a slot online and skip the queue.
